description: Grades your x402 resource server under fault injection (R0-R10): it must never serve content on a /settle timeout, an HTML 502, a 503 with a success body, a non-JSON or truncated answer, settlement_pending, a failed transaction or a duplicate payment. Pays with test payloads through the facilitator double only; the URL must be on loopback and your server must use the double (x402_start_facilitator_double) as its facilitator.

network.description: Network to pay on; default auto

resource_url.description: Your paid route on loopback, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4020/paid

name: x402_probe_resource_server
title: Probe your resource server (R0-R10)
